annotation.summary_en: A man notices his police officer neighbor has been promoted overnight and questions him about which of their friends he had to arrest to get the rank.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a dimly lit, wood-paneled apartment hallway featuring wooden doors and wall sconces. A man wearing a light-colored uniform shirt and tie is seen sneaking through the corridor, cautiously checking doors. In a quick cut, a man wearing only briefs is seen fleeing past a police officer in a cap on a stairwell. The main interaction occurs between two neighbors in the hallway. One man, wearing a black turtleneck, confronts his neighbor, who is dressed in a police uniform. The man in the turtleneck expresses shock at the officer's sudden promotion, noting that he was a lieutenant just yesterday but is now a captain. He jokingly asks if the officer busted a major criminal gang involving their mutual friends or arrested 'Chelovek Papuk' to earn the new stripes. The officer remains dismissive, repeating a cryptic line about how there is always 'something' to deal with at their house. The scene ends with an animated argument where one man swings his arm at the other.
catchphrases: մեր տանը միշտ էլ բան կա
երեկ լեյտենանտ էիր էսօր կապիտան ես
